run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T15:18:31Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by a burst of HTTP 500s in frontend that started immediately after the ad and payment Deployments were both rolled out to a new ReplicaSet (revision 1 -> 2) at 15:16:57-15:17:01, which deleted the old pods ad-554b849958-mbnxm and payment-55766d76b9-c4wgb. Frontend's own error spans (1734.5 spans in the trailing hour at 15:34:31) are almost entirely downstream-connectivity failures: 4 series x 387.1 spans (~1549, ~89%) on the ad path (grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, GET /api/data and its internal server spans) and 4 x 42.7 spans (~171, ~10%) on the checkout path (grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, POST /api/checkout), plus 15.2 tcp.connect error spans. Traces carry the exact diagnostics: frontend's GetAds client spans end with gRPC code 14 'UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080' where 100.65.180.246 is the ad Service ClusterIP, and checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client span ends with code 14 'dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused' where 100.70.188.60 is the payment Service ClusterIP; no ad or payment server span exists in those traces because the requests never reached those services. Frontend's 5-minute error count was exactly 0 up to 15:17:36, peaked at 1193.3 spans at 15:22:36, and returned to 0 by 15:29:36. The ad Service's own GetAds server spans dropped to zero from the 5-minute bucket ending 15:22:36 through 15:26:36 and resumed at 15:27:36; the ad container's first log line between 15:14 and 15:34 is a 'Targeted ad request received' at 15:25:29 and payment's first is 'Charge request received' at 15:24:40, i.e. the new containers accepted no traffic for roughly 7-8 minutes after their containers started, while both Deployments define no readinessProbe/livenessProbe/startupProbe and use RollingUpdate 25%/25% with no minReadySeconds. So a template update on both Deployments replaced the only serving pods and the Service endpoints moved to pods whose 8080 listener was not yet accepting connections, producing connection-refused errors in frontend and checkout and firing the alert. The exact template field that changed, why the new containers took minutes to listen, and the alert rule's expression remain unverified.

claims.text: Frontend is producing error spans: at 15:34:31 frontend had 1734.53 error-status spans in the trailing hour, while accounting, cart, payment, shipping, email, currency, product-catalog and quote returned 0 error spans in the same query.

Frontend's error spans are broken down by operation as GET 387.15, GET /api/data 387.15, executing api route (pages) /api/data 387.15, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 387.15, POST 42.68, POST /api/checkout 42.68, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 42.68, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 42.68 and tcp.connect 15.24 (increase over 1h at 15:34:31); GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart and the CartService client spans show 0 errors.

Frontend total spans by operation and status show the same window: GET/UNSET 17489.6, GET/ERROR 387.1, GET /api/data/UNSET 1448.0, GET /api/data/ERROR 387.1, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds/UNSET 1448.0 and /ERROR 387.1, POST/UNSET 4854.0 and /ERROR 42.7, POST /api/checkout/UNSET 1162.5 and /ERROR 42.7 (increase over 1h at 15:34:31).

Frontend's 5-minute error-span increase was 0 from 15:09:36 through 15:17:36, then 101.1 at 15:18:36, peaking at 1193.3 at 15:22:36, and back to 0 at 15:29:36; within frontend, GET /api/data (with grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds) and POST /api/checkout (with grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) follow the same shape, the checkout path ending at 15:23:36 and the ad path ending at 15:28:36.

Frontend 500s on /api/data are caused by the ad dependency: frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans carry status rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and the detail '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080', and the ad Service's ClusterIP is 100.65.180.246 port 8080; the two traces examined (39738559ae15135780326c17f7d13235, b6372c024d7931e1d115ceda2651efe8) contain no ad service span.

Trace ec1cee4987517d5f90408dca5e4e0bc0 (15:17:56) shows the checkout path end to end: frontend POST /api/checkout 500 -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error 13 -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error 13 with description 'failed to charge card ...' -> checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge error with rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and description 'connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused"'; the payment Service ClusterIP is 100.70.188.60:8080 and no payment span appears in the trace.

The same error text appears in the frontend error-span sample: '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card ... rpc error: code = Unavailable ... dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused' on executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans with http.status_code 500, and '14 UNAVAILABLE ... connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080' on executing api route (pages) /api/data spans.

Both dependencies' pods were replaced by their Deployment controllers just before the errors began: at 15:16:57 'Scaled up replica set ad-6cb57f76d from 0 to 1' and 'Created pod: ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6', at 15:17:00 'Killing ad-554b849958-mbnxm' and 'Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-mbnxm' and 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0'; identically for payment (Scaled up payment-9c8ffb665, Created payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84, Killing payment-55766d76b9-c4wgb, SuccessfulDelete, Scaled down payment-55766d76b9) at 15:16:57-15:17:01.

The ad and payment ReplicaSets show a template change scoped to those two Deployments: ad-554b849958 (created 14:43:13Z, revision 1, replicas 0) and payment-55766d76b9 (created 14:43:12Z, revision 1, replicas 0) versus ad-6cb57f76d and payment-9c8ffb665 (both created 15:16:57Z, revision 2, replicas 1), with identical image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad / :2.1.3-payment) and identical visible env in both revisions.

The new pods ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 (podIP 100.96.4.142) and payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 (podIP 100.96.4.221) were Ready at 15:17:00Z and 15:17:01Z respectively with container restartCount 0, running state startedAt 15:16:59Z/15:17:00Z and services ad/payment select opentelemetry.io/name=ad|payment, which both pods carry; current Endpoints list exactly these two pod IPs on port 8080.

Both Deployments define the container port 8080 but no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe (all null), use strategy RollingUpdate with maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25% and no minReadySeconds, and carry deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=2 with status.observedGeneration=2 (Helm release otel-demo), so Kubernetes marked the new pods Ready as soon as their containers started.

The ad service received no GetAds traffic for several minutes after the rollout: ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span increase per 5 minutes falls from 223.3 at 15:18:36 to 41.0 at 15:21:36, is exactly 0 at 15:22:36, 15:23:36, 15:24:36, 15:25:36 and 15:26:36, and resumes at 100.9 at 15:27:36 (status 0 error spans throughout).

The new containers show request logs only from about 15:24:40 onward: the ad container's log lines in 15:14:00-15:34:36 begin at 15:25:29 with 'Targeted ad request received', and the payment container's begin at 15:24:40 with 'Charge request received' / 'Transaction complete' pairs (no error lines in the payment output).

Only the ad and payment call paths failed among the services frontend/checkout touch: in the same failing checkout trace, checkout's CartService/GetCart, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and CurrencyService/Convert client spans (and cart, product-catalog, currency server spans) returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and the per-service error-span query returned 0 for accounting, cart, payment, shipping, email, currency, product-catalog and quote.

At query time all 21 otel-demo Deployments report desired 1 / available 1 / ready 1 / updated 1, the ad and payment containers report restartCount 0 with no terminated lastState, all 5 nodes report Ready with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, PIDPressure and NetworkUnavailable all False, and the replaced pods are accounted for by their own Deployment controller (ScalingReplicaSet + SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete).

Frontend's error-span share measured from the same family of series was 1.75-1.87% over the trailing hour between 15:24:36 and 15:34:36 (1.7533% at 15:34:36), i.e. the same order of magnitude as the alert annotation value 2.5777 but not equal to it.

Most likely cause of the alert: the simultaneous template update of the ad and payment Deployments at 15:16:57 replaced their only serving pods; because neither Deployment has a readiness/startup probe, the Service endpoints switched to the new pods before their gRPC listeners on 8080 accepted connections, so the ad ClusterIP (100.65.180.246) and payment ClusterIP (100.70.188.60) answered 'connection refused' from ~15:17:40, producing frontend HTTP 500s on /api/data and /api/checkout and the error-span burst the alert reports.

Secondary open question: the ~7-8 minute period during which the new ad and payment containers logged no requests (ad GetAds spans zero 15:22:36-15:26:36, ad log starts 15:25:29, payment log starts 15:24:40) is longer than container start, so part of the error period may also be gRPC client channel backoff/reconnect in frontend and checkout rather than literal listener downtime; the split between the two cannot be measured with the retained logs.

Rejected: a payment application-level failure (e.g. declined charges) caused the checkout errors. Payment's own error spans are 0, payment's logs from 15:24:40 show only 'Charge request received'/'Transaction complete', checkout's Charge client span failed at transport level with code 14 connection refused, and no payment server span exists in the failing trace.

Rejected: an ad application-level error or flagd fault-injection response caused frontend's GetAds failures. The failures are transport-level gRPC 14 'No connection established ... ECONNREFUSED', ad's GetAds spans carry status STATUS_CODE_UNSET and never appear as errors, no ad server span exists in the failing traces, and the only ad error spans in the window are flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream spans at ~1 span/hour, unchanged across the window.

Rejected: node-level pressure, eviction or OOM damage to the ad/payment pods. All 5 nodes report Ready with MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure False, the new pods have restartCount 0 and no terminated lastState (no OOMKilled), and the old pods were deleted by their own Deployment controller via ScalingReplicaSet/SuccessfulDelete with a matching SuccessfulCreate for the new pods - a rollout, not damage.

Rejected: a fault in frontend itself (its own code/config) caused the alert. Frontend's pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-h8sk5 has been running since 14:43:14Z with 0 restarts, its error spans are 500s wrapping downstream gRPC codes 13/14 with explicit downstream connection-refused descriptions, its own local route handlers for /api/cart and CartService calls show 0 errors, and its error spans return to 0 by 15:29:36 without any frontend change.

Rejected: DNS resolution failure at frontend/checkout. The client errors name the correct service IPs (ad 100.65.180.246:8080, payment 100.70.188.60:8080), i.e. name resolution succeeded and the failure was at connect time; frontend's dns.lookup spans carry no error status.

Add a readinessProbe (and a startupProbe with a generous failureThreshold) on the ad and payment containers' 8080 port and set minReadySeconds on otel-demo/ad and otel-demo/payment, so a replaced pod is not added to the Service endpoints before its gRPC listener is accepting connections.

Use change history or release tooling to identify what changed in the ad and payment pod templates at 15:16:57Z (revision 1 -> 2, same image and same visible env), and whether a single Helm upgrade of release otel-demo touched both workloads.

gaps: The alerting rule itself is not retrievable: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules at all (empty, no_data) both for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and unfiltered, so the alert's exact PromQL expression, threshold and evaluation window are unknown, and the annotation value 2.5777 could not be reproduced (frontend's measured error-span share was 1.75-1.87% over the trailing hour).

Change history is a not-integrated source in this Run, so who or what applied the ad and payment pod-template update at 15:16:57Z, and which template field changed (old and new ReplicaSets show the same image and env in the fields examined), could not be verified.
Frontend container logs were unavailable (0 lines read for frontend-675fd7b5c5-h8sk5 in 15:16:00-15:30:00), so frontend's own application log evidence for the 500s could not be checked.

kube-state-metrics series were absent in this Prometheus: kube_pod_container_info returned no series and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/min_over_time returned no data, so no historical pod/ReplicaSet availability timeline exists; Kubernetes objects reflect only their state at query time.

The ad container's logs before 15:25:29Z and the payment container's before 15:24:40Z are not available, so the reason the new containers accepted no connections for roughly 7-8 minutes after their 15:16:59Z/15:17:00Z start (slow application start vs. something else) could not be determined.

No Warning-type events were returned for namespace otel-demo in the window (the events query was filtered and returned no_data after 18 non-Warning events), and events expire, so absence of probe-failure or scheduling warnings is unknown rather than proven.

gRPC status breakdown from rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count is unavailable: no series with rpc_grpc_status_code != 0 and no rpc_grpc_status_code label values were returned, so gRPC error rates could not be corroborated from that metric family.
Whether the alert has now resolved is unknown: the last frontend error metric points are 0 from 15:29:36 to 15:31:36 (data as of 15:31:36), but no Alertmanager state after 15:34:36 was queried.
Consequences beyond the observed 500s (for example customer-visible sessions other than the sampled traces, or downstream business impact) were not observed and are unverified.
next_steps: Compare the old and new ad/payment ReplicaSet pod templates field by field (annotations, resources, checksum annotations) to identify the 15:16:57Z change.
Add readiness/startup probes and minReadySeconds to otel-demo/ad and otel-demo/payment so a rollout cannot remove the last listening backend.
Check Alertmanager for the RequestErrorRate rule definition and current state, and confirm whether it has resolved since frontend errors stopped at ~15:28:40Z.
Review container start-to-listening time for the 2.1.3-ad and 2.1.3-payment images (the new containers served no traffic for ~7 minutes after start).
